en: Job 15

p.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

p.src: 2  “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

en: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
u.src: 2  “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

p.src: 3  Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

ja: な話や、 何の益にもならない
en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
u.src: 3  Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

p.src: 4  Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

ja: まことに、あなたは神への恐れを
en: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
u.src: 4  Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

p.src: 5  For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

ja: あなたの咎があなたの
え、 あなたは悪賢い
en: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
u.src: 5  For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

p.src: 6  Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

ja: あなた自身の口があなたを
ではない。 そうだ、あなた
en: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
u.src: 6  Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

p.src: 7  “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

ja: なのか。 あるいは、丘よりも
にあなたは産み出されたのか。
en: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
u.src: 7  “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

p.src: 8  Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

ja: いたのか。 あなたは
だけのものとしているのか。
en: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
u.src: 8  Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

p.src: 9  What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

ja: らない何を、あなたは知るのか。 私たちにないどんな悟りが、あなたにあるのか。
en: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
u.src: 9  What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

p.src: 10  With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

en: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
u.src: 10  With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

p.src: 11  Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

ja: さすぎるのか。 あなたへの優しい
en: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
u.src: 11  Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

p.src: 12  Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

ja: はあなたを駆り立てるのか。 なぜあなたの
en: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
u.src: 12  Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

p.src: 13  that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

ja: らわせ、 このような言葉をあなたの
en: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
u.src: 13  that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

p.src: 14  What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

en: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
u.src: 14  What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

p.src: 15  Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

ja: を置かれない。 まことに、
en: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
u.src: 15  Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

p.src: 16  how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

en: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
u.src: 16  how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

p.src: 17  “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

ja: たことを私は宣言しよう。
en: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
u.src: 17  “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

p.src: 18  (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

ja: たちから告げ知らされたことであり、 隠してはこなかった。
en: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
u.src: 18  (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

p.src: 19  to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

en: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
u.src: 19  to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

p.src: 20  the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

ja: 痛に身もだえし、 虐げる
en: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
u.src: 20  the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

p.src: 21  A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

ja: を離れない。 繁栄の
en: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
u.src: 21  A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

p.src: 22  He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

en: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
u.src: 22  He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

p.src: 23  He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

ja: めてさまよい歩き、「それはどこにあるのか」と
が自分の手元に迫っていることを
en: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
u.src: 23  He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

p.src: 24  Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

en: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
u.src: 24  Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

p.src: 25  Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

ja: 慢に振る舞ったからだ。
en: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
u.src: 25  Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

p.src: 26  he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

en: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
u.src: 26  he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

p.src: 27  because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

en: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
u.src: 27  because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

p.src: 28  He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

ja: む者もなく、 石塚となる
en: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
u.src: 28  He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

p.src: 29  He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

ja: も続くことはない。 その富が
en: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
u.src: 29  He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

p.src: 30  He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

ja: から離れることはない。
によって吹き払われる。
en: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
u.src: 30  He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

p.src: 31  Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

ja: いてはならない。 むなしいものが
en: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
u.src: 31  Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

p.src: 32  It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

en: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
u.src: 32  It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

p.src: 33  He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

en: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
u.src: 33  He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

p.src: 34  For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

ja: まりは実を結ばず、 火は
en: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
u.src: 34  For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

p.src: 35  They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

en: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
u.src: 35  They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
